description.html: This 70x45x70 cm terrarium (220.5 L) is made of quality glass and covered on the outside with film of your choice. The film gives the terrarium a neat look that fits your interior, with wood, bamboo and marble patterns or solid black or white available.

The horizontal layout with 70 cm of length gives a floor area where a basking zone, a cool zone and a hiding area are easy to arrange. Terrestrial reptiles actively choose their temperature by moving between zones, and this space lets them do that. Mesh ventilation openings provide the airflow animals need to stay healthy and prevent condensation.

The terrarium is ordered with your choice of film and background. For non-standard requests (other dimensions, double sliding glass panels, a built-in thermostat), write to us or call. Free consultations and delivery to all cities.
